intent: Initial balanced geometry with 5 medium-sized sensors evenly spaced near the front, moderate body size and mass, and medium wheel radius and track. This aims to provide good line sensing and stable handling as a baseline for controller development and telemetry gathering.
rationale: Since this is the first iteration, we have no integration feedback or race telemetry yet. To start, I propose a balanced geometry with moderate body size and mass, a mid-sized sensor array with 5 sensors evenly spaced near the front, and medium wheel radius and track width. This setup aims to provide good line sensing coverage and stable handling without excessive mass or size that could hinder agility. The intent is to establish a baseline geometry that is neither extreme nor minimal, allowing the integrator to build a controller and gather initial telemetry to inform future refinements. We request measurements on completion, progress, completion_time, rms_error, line_loss_events, and steering_oscillation to diagnose line following performance and control stability in the next iteration.
